newsitem.title: USA: Signet to sell unit to Bank of NY.
newsitem.headline: Signet to sell unit to Bank of NY.

text.p: Signet Banking Corp on Tuesday said it has signed a definitive agreement to sell its Corporate Trust unit to The Bank of New York Co Inc.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
Bank of New York said that the the transaction is expected to close in the third quarter, and that the deal will add to earnings immediately.
The acquisition involves the transfer to The Bank of New York of about 700 bond trustee and agency relationships primarily for municipalities located in Virginia and Maryland, Bank of New York said.
Signet announced its intention to sell the business in March of this year, noting that while it was profitable, it required a large investment to remain competitive in a consolidating environment.
